summary: Saudi-led coalition forces conducted military operations against Houthi targets in Yemen's Al Hudaydah governorate following Red Sea shipping attacks. Iran's IRGC claimed missile strikes on a Kuwaiti base hosting US forces and a Bahraini facility housing the US Fifth Fleet. Meanwhile, a deadly shooting near the West Bank village of Tell left one Israeli and four Palestinians dead, prompting IDF manhunts and closures.
key_points: Saudi-led coalition struck Houthi military targets in Al Hudaydah, Yemen, asserting compliance with international law and confirming Hodeidah port remains open. (Source: @VahidOnline/77487)
IRGC claimed responsibility for missile attacks on Al-Adiri base in Kuwait and US Fifth Fleet observation tower in Bahrain. (Source: @yediotnews25/133155)

IDF and Shin Bet overnight destroyed Hamas weapons warehouses, manufacturing sites, and underground infrastructure in Gaza, with secondary explosions confirming munitions presence. (Source: @idf_telegram/24715)

Shooting near West Bank village of Tell killed Israeli security coordinator Binyahu Melet and four Palestinians; seven others injured; IDF imposed closures on Tell and Nablus. (Source: @manniefabian/58841, @inon_yttach/9640)
Iranian Khatam al-Anbiya commander Ali Abdollahi declared new retaliation equation: "for every Iranian citizen killed, we will kill one American." (Source: @New_security8200/202952)
US forces disabled the M/T Lavine in the Gulf of Oman after it attempted to run a blockade at least four times. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/5705)
US Embassy Jerusalem warned citizens of potential unexpected escalation, flight cancellations, and airspace closure. (Source: @amitsegal/63362)

Missile attacks hit Saudi Arabia's Jizan industrial city causing power outages; fires reported in Jizan and Yanbu after launches from Yemen. (Source: @presstv/200245, @naya_foriraq/85456, @naya_foriraq/85488)

sections.executive_summary: Saudi-led coalition forces conducted military operations against Houthi targets in Yemen's Al Hudaydah governorate following Red Sea shipping attacks. Iran's IRGC claimed missile strikes on a Kuwaiti base hosting US forces and a Bahraini facility housing the US Fifth Fleet. Meanwhile, a deadly shooting near the West Bank village of Tell left one Israeli and four Palestinians dead, prompting IDF manhunts and closures.

points: IRGC claimed responsibility for missile attacks on Al-Adiri base in Kuwait and the US Fifth Fleet observation tower in Bahrain, per Tasnim news agency, marking a direct escalation against US regional military presence. (Source: @yediotnews25/133155)

Commander of Khatam al-Anbiya, Ali Abdollahi, declared a new retaliation equation: "for every Iranian citizen killed, we will kill one American," threatening direct targeting of US personnel. (Source: @New_security8200/202952)
Reports indicate a US attack this morning on an IRGC naval base in Zibakenar, Gilan province, suggesting kinetic action against Iranian maritime assets. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/77668)
CENTCOM reportedly confirmed arrival of ground combat equipment for a US-Israel ground maneuver for entry into Iran, indicating advanced contingency planning. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/77681)

Chinese Foreign Minister expressed support for Iran's sovereignty and deep concern over Middle East escalation, endorsing multilateral mediation including the Islamabad agreement. (Source: @SharghDaily/174212)
Former US President Trump stated Iran wants a deal but is not ready, dismissing negative reports as fake news. (Source: @naya_foriraq/85474)
A CBS reporter claimed the White House has a special plan for the defeat and destruction of Iran's regime, citing access to classified information. (Source: @kianmeli1/90024)

IDF and Shin Bet conducted overnight strikes across Gaza, destroying Hamas weapons warehouses storing Kalashnikovs, RPGs, mortars, explosives, and underground infrastructure; secondary explosions confirmed munitions presence. (Source: @idf_telegram/24715)

Deadly shooting near West Bank village of Tell killed Israeli security coordinator Binyahu Melet, 32, and wounded two other Israelis; four Palestinians killed and four wounded per PA health ministry. (Source: @manniefabian/58841, @inon_yttach/9640)

IDF launched manhunt for Palestinian gunmen, imposed closures on Tell and Nablus, and announced exit restrictions and force buildup across Judea and Samaria for extensive operations. (Source: @manniefabian/58841, @yediotnews25/133153)
US Embassy Jerusalem warned American citizens to exercise increased caution, stay alert, and prepare for possible flight cancellations and airspace closure due to tension. (Source: @amitsegal/63362)
IDF confirmed names of two fallen soldiers with families notified; details published on official IDF website. (Source: @idf_telegram/24712)
Missing 4-year-old Yuval Kogan was found safe in Ashkelon after large-scale search involving police, Shin Bet, and border police units. (Source: @amitsegal/63348, @almogboker78/17810)

Artillery shelling reported in southern Lebanon at Talusa, Nabatieh al-Fawqa, and an explosion in Majdal Zoun, indicating continued cross-border fire. (Source: @redlinkleb/32795, @redlinkleb/32832, @redlinkleb/32818)

IDF and Shin Bet struck Hamas terror infrastructure in multiple Gaza areas overnight, targeting weapons warehouses, manufacturing sites, and underground facilities; Hamas accused of systematically violating ceasefire and rebuilding military capabilities. (Source: @idf_telegram/24715)

Shooting incident near Tell village, West Bank: Israeli settlers reported attack while hiking; security coordinator's weapon stolen and used to fire on civilians; one Israeli dead, two injured (one serious, one moderate). (Source: @manniefabian/58841)
Palestinian Authority health ministry reported four Palestinians killed and four wounded in the same incident near Tell. (Source: @manniefabian/58840)

IDF Duvdevan unit under Shomron Brigade and Shin Bet guidance arrested two wounded terrorists in Nablus hospital who participated in the Tell shooting; identities of all perpetrators known. (Source: @idf_telegram/24713)
IDF imposed closure on Tell and Nablus, deployed additional troops, set up roadblocks, and announced extensive activity across Judea and Samaria. (Source: @yediotnews25/133153)
Initial reports of gunfire in Havat Gilad settlement triggered the response; further details under review. (Source: @manniefabian/58837)
Footage circulated showing altercation between Israelis and Palestinians in Tell village during the incident. (Source: @manniefabian/58844)
Artillery shelling reported in Talusa area of southern Lebanon, with live map reference provided. (Source: @redlinkleb/32795)
Artillery shelling reported in Nabatieh al-Fawqa region, with live map reference. (Source: @redlinkleb/32832)
Explosion heard in western sector attributed to enemy detonation in Majdal Zoun. (Source: @redlinkleb/32818)

Cross-border fire continues along Blue Line with Israeli artillery targeting locations in southern Lebanon amid heightened regional tension. (Source: @redlinkleb/32795, @redlinkleb/32832, @redlinkleb/32818)
Iraqi army columns moved toward the main headquarters of the Popular Mobilization Forces (PMF), indicating potential internal security tensions. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/77671)
US forces disabled the M/T Lavine in the Gulf of Oman after the vessel attempted to run a blockade at least four times, per CENTCOM spokesman Capt. Tim Hawkins. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/5705)
Earthquake felt by residents in Sulaymaniyah governorate, northern Iraq, though not conflict-related. (Source: @naya_foriraq/85435)
Regional actors monitor Iraqi territory for potential use as launchpad for attacks on US or Israeli interests given IRGC threats. (Source: @New_security8200/202952, @rodast_omiddana/77681)

Saudi-led coalition executed military operations against Houthi military targets in Al Hudaydah governorate, Yemen, in response to Houthi targeting of commercial ships in Red Sea; spokesperson Turki al-Maliki stated operation complied with international law and achieved objectives. (Source: @VahidOnline/77487)
Saudi-owned vessel NCC Masa sustained minor hull damage after being targeted while sailing in Red Sea on Friday; vessel continued to destination, all crew safe. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/5715)
Houthi Foreign Ministry accused Saudi government of refusing demands to lift blockade on Yemen after Saudi strikes hit Hodeidah, per NYT. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/5713)

Missile attacks hit Saudi Arabia's Jizan industrial city, causing power cuts in several areas; large fires reported in Jizan after missile launches from Yemen. (Source: @presstv/200245, @naya_foriraq/85456)
Powerful explosions rocked Saudi port city of Yanbu amid Saudi attacks on Yemen; latest missile wave targeted Yanbu governorate. (Source: @presstv/200246, @naya_foriraq/85488)
IRGC claimed missile strikes on Al-Adiri base in Kuwait and US Fifth Fleet observation tower in Bahrain, expanding threat to Gulf state hosting US forces. (Source: @yediotnews25/133155)
US forces disabled M/T Lavine in Gulf of Oman after blockade-running attempts, demonstrating continued maritime interdiction operations. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/5705)

key_developments: Saudi-led coalition struck Houthi military targets in Al Hudaydah, Yemen, after Red Sea shipping attacks; Hodeidah port not targeted, all Yemeni ports remain open
